Do not add any. Do not touch files outside your task's `Files:` line; in particular leave `README.md`, `test.md`, `.the-framework/`, `.agents/`, `.claude/` and `.openagent/` alone. Every new page must match the style of `index.html`. Copy its `` exactly (charset, viewport, the comment about relative favicon links, both `` tags with relative hrefs `favicon.ico` and `favicon.svg`), changing only ``. Keep its CSS as-is (dark `#0f172a` background, the same font stack, body centered with flex, `h1` in `#f8fafc` at 3rem weight 600), and add only what a page with more than a heading needs: - `flex-direction: column;` on `html, body` so items stack. - body text (`p`, `li`) in `#cbd5e1`, `font-size: 1.125rem`, `line-height: 1.6`, `max-width: 40rem`, and `padding: 0 1.5rem` on the content so it doesn't touch the edges. - links (`a`) in `#f8fafc` with an underline.
